job.purpose: S&P 500 15 minute series (KXINX15M), one minute candles (period_interval 1) of each development market from 30 minutes before its close to 120 seconds before its close, keeping every price field and open_interest, for the SPXOI1 threshold. Tickers are built from the close time (KXINX15M-26NOV131145-45 closes 11:45 AM ET).
job.heldout: Development dates only, Nov 5 to Nov 13, 2026, nothing after Nov 13. The Head of R&D (2026-11-13 16:45Z): SPXFV1 and SPXOI1 HELDOUT_FIRST 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z (registry 8323d0b7); INX1 now reads 'no KXINX15M window read'. Every date in this job is before the held-out.
job.notes: One ticker a request, 143 requests (13, 23, 25, 25, 25, 25 and 7 by day for Nov 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13), about 3 minutes at 1 s pacing. Schedule from the Head's public list read of 2026-11-13 16:40Z: Nov 5 closes 18:00Z to 21:00Z, Nov 6 15:30Z to 21:00Z, Nov 9 to 12 15:00Z to 21:00Z (15:00Z = 10:00 ET, EST is UTC-5); tickers that do not exist are not asked. Nov 13 stops at 16:30Z (11:30 ET) so no window still open is read. The 30 minute start leaves slack for a market that opened later. Registration: Desk A commit 94c4dfbc, cards file kalshi-scalper/workers/DESK_A_SPX_CARDS_NOV13.md sha256 bb7e1e4a01ef21b12b98b8ba414873eb19fbc7fb45aede7458ba3cd22669b807 (CLEAN by Auditor B). End of each read is the close minus 120 s (Auditor B's recommendation, as the V1 job): it still covers the open interest candles ending 360 s and 180 s before the close and the 180 to 120 s entry minutes, and leaves the final two minutes, which show the outcome, unread.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
